acceptance_precondition: readiness_gate_contract.json's gate call must return status=READY before any field above may be populated with a real, non-null value.
note: This defines what a future ACCEPTED scientific baseline prediction artifact must contain. It is not itself an accepted artifact, and building this contract does not create one.

configuration_hash.note: Computable today from the literal configs/analysis/core.yaml bytes, but withheld here since it is only meaningful bound together with the two hashes above.

deterministic_artifact_id.note: Deterministic over baseline_id, target_name, and the three direct inputs below. Cannot be minted for real until fold_manifest_hash and oracle_target_hash are real.

exact_artifact_authorization.note: Scoped to exactly one target_artifact_id, never a wildcard by baseline type or owner -- cannot exist until deterministic_artifact_id above is real.

fold_manifest_hash.source: person_b sealed fold manifest, see scientific_baseline_input_contract.json

prediction_rows.note: Empty: no prediction rows exist because no real baseline has been fit.
